items.title: File Einspruch against the 2024 income tax assessment
items.quote: Der Einspruch ist innerhalb eines Monats nach Bekanntgabe dieses Bescheids beim Finanzamt Beispielhausen, Am Musterwall 7, 31134 Beispielhausen, schriftlich oder elektronisch einzulegen oder dort zur Niederschrift zu erklären.
items.computation: Letter dated Mon 27 Oct 2025, sent by ordinary post, so it counts as delivered (§ 122 Abs. 2 Nr. 1 AO) on the 4th day after posting = Fri 31 Oct 2025. That day is a public holiday (Reformationstag) in Niedersachsen, so delivery shifts to the next working day, Mon 3 Nov 2025 (§ 108 Abs. 3 AO). The one-month Einspruch period (§ 355 Abs. 1 AO) starts the following day (§ 187 Abs. 1 BGB, § 108 Abs. 1 AO) and ends one month later on Wed 3 Dec 2025 (§ 188 Abs. 2 BGB). 3 Dec 2025 is a Wednesday and not a holiday, so it stays as the deadline.

items.title: Refund of overpaid tax to be paid out
items.quote: Die Auszahlung erfolgt in den nächsten Tagen auf das bekannte Konto.
items.computation: The letter only says the refund will be paid out 'in the next few days' to the account already on file, without giving an exact date. No precise due date can be derived from this wording.
